use_case: AI-assisted emergency call triage: live transcription of calls with suggested call type, response priority, and critical-keyword alerts inside CAD; upgrade prompts only
vendor_or_model: CAD vendor AI module (speech-to-text plus a language model classifier), vendor cloud service
data_categories: Live call audio; transcripts; caller-reported symptoms and location; suggested call type and priority (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Telecommunicators complete the emergency medical dispatch protocol and set every priority; the AI may only prompt an upgrade, never a downgrade; no automatic dispatch; dismissals are logged and sampled weekly
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (CAD vendor is a business associate; AI amendment pending); 45 CFR 92.210 (patient care decision support tool; the company receives Medicaid funds); Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(g) (recording by a licensed ambulance service; counsel to confirm line coverage); Fla. Stat. 501.171; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production (advisory mode at the primary center since 2026-05-01; limited to English-language calls from 2026-09-16)

use_case: ePCR narrative drafting: vendor feature that drafts the patient care narrative from structured fields entered by the crew
data_categories: Structured patient care fields; draft narrative (ePHI)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); re-tier to Health care if it suggests treatments
human_in_the_loop: Crew must review, edit, and attest to every narrative before signing
applicable_laws: HIPAA (covered by the ePCR BAA once the vendor confirms no training on customer data); Fla. Stat. 401.30(1) (accurate records)

use_case: Billing coding assistance: billing platform module that suggests level of service and diagnosis codes from the ePCR narrative for company and client claims
vendor_or_model: Billing platform vendor AI module (language model classifier)
data_categories: ePCR narratives; structured trip data; suggested codes; claims (ePHI, including client PHI)
human_in_the_loop: Certified coders review and approve every suggestion before claim release (straight-through coding ends by 2026-10-01 under the 2026-09-16 decision); monthly accuracy audit
applicable_laws: 42 CFR 401.305 (report and return overpayments within 60 days of identification); 42 CFR 410.40 and 410.41(c) (ambulance coverage and billing); HIPAA (billing vendor BAA and client BAAs)
status: In production since 2025-11 (straight-through coding ends by 2026-10-01; look-back review ordered)

use_case: Demand forecasting and unit posting recommendations: model that forecasts call demand by hour and area and recommends posting locations to communications supervisors
vendor_or_model: Company-configured forecasting model in the data and reporting account, feeding the CAD posting module
data_categories: De-identified CAD incident history (time, location, call type); unit status; posting plans
human_in_the_loop: Supervisors approve every unit move; overrides logged; minimum coverage rules per zone set by people, not the model
applicable_laws: County A and County B agreements (response-time standards); not a patient care decision support tool under 45 CFR 92.4

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for drafting letters, procedures, and summaries
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI service under an enterprise agreement with a BAA and a no-training term
data_categories: Internal documents; no PHI, caller, or client data during the pilot
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output; no decisions about individuals
applicable_laws: HIPAA (BAA in place; PHI not allowed during the pilot); POL-05 4.8
status: Proposed (pilot with 40 administrative staff since 2026-08; public chatbots prohibited for PHI)
